title: The Reckoning Begins
next_chapter_hook: As Elder Zhou was escorted down the stone steps of the Council Hall by two Law Enforcement disciples, he suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly—that laughter sharp and mournful like a night owl: 'Chen Ji! Do you think killing me is the end? The chess game of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, an ant like you cannot possibly understand!'

text.content: The fragmented map gleamed with an eerie bronze-green sheen under the flickering candlelight. Chen Ji's slender fingers traced the marked pathways with deliberate slowness. The Forbidden Grounds Entrance—three ancient seal characters that pierced his vision like three sharp blades. The fact that the Ancient Forbidden Land coincided with the ruins of the Demonic Holy Sect was no mere coincidence. He tucked the map into his sleeve, his gaze hardening like ice in a frozen abyss. The evidence gathered over seven days was sufficient—it was time for the reckoning. Elder Zhou, your fortunate days have come to an end. He rose, pushed open the door, and stepped into the night. Cold wind poured into his robes, yet it could not disperse the murderous intent radiating from his very being.

dialogue.content: Issue the order—half an hour from now, hold an emergency Council Hall meeting. Tell them this: the matter of the Demonic Path Saintess's visit requires an explanation for the entire sect.

text.content: The messenger disciple hesitated. Usually this useless senior brother kept such a low profile he was nearly invisible, yet today he suddenly radiated a terrifying pressure. He dared not question further, bowed, and hurried off with the order. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back beneath the corridor, a faint, indifferent curve forming at the corner of his lips. An explanation? What he intended to give was far more than mere explanation. Moments later, he strode toward the Council Hall, his robe hem stirring fallen leaves, silently heralding the coming storm.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emerged from the first page of the Tianji Record, his cold voice resonating in Chen Ji's Mental Sea) The time has come. This old one has observed this man for months—all his jade slip communications with Xuanwu Sect's secret envoys are on record. But—how do you plan to strike?

text.content: Chen Ji kept walking, responding within his Mental Sea: 'The evidence must be presented piece by piece. First, let him think he still has a way out. When he has no more arguments to make, then we reveal our trump card.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly, emitting a knowing chuckle: 'In the past, Chen Xuan used this exact move when laying out his schemes across the realm—the strategy of luring the enemy into the jar. You learn quickly.' Chen Ji offered no reply, though a cold gleam flickered through his eyes. Playing the fool for so long, he'd nearly forgotten the ruthless blood that coursed through his veins.

Inside the Council Hall, candles blazed bright. More than a dozen elders stood in rows on both sides, and in the central master's chair sat Mo Xiansheng's illusory form. Elder Zhou occupied the end seat, his expression unchanged as he lifted his teacup for a delicate sip—yet a subtle hint of cruelty flickered in his eyes. The scandal of the Demonic Path Saintess's visit had caused quite a stir. He wanted to see what these people could possibly uncover. Just then, footsteps echoed from outside the hall—steady and unhurried, yet carrying an oppressive weight that stole the breath.

dialogue.content: (Han Lie stood with arms crossed in the hall's center, his thick brows furrowed, glaring coldly at the entrance) This废物 arrives with quite the bearing. What does he think he is—a servant disciple daring to convene a sect council meeting?

text.content: Clad in cyan robes, Chen Ji strode slowly into the Council Hall. He did not look at Han Lie, did not even glance at any elder—directly walking to the empty space in the hall's center before turning to face the assembly. His gaze was calm to the point of indifference, like a lake's surface in deep winter, betraying no trace of emotion. 'Elder gentlemen,' he began, his voice not loud yet clearly reaching every ear, 'I have summoned you today regarding a momentous case of treason and betrayal against the sect.' The words sent murmurs rippling through the hall. Elder Zhou's teacup trembled slightly in his grip, tea threatening to spill.

choice.prompt: The evidence of Elder Zhou's treason and betrayal of the sect is ready. Chen Ji must choose how to unveil this reckoning—

choices.text: Reveal the evidence directly and crush him
choices.description: Starting with an explosive opening! Publicly broadcast the intercepted jade slip communications, leaving Elder Zhou no room to prevaricate, crushing his侥幸心理 with the most violent method possible.
choices.visible_cost: Expose all trump cards at once
choices.visible_reward: Completely intimidate everyone present, establishing absolute authority
choices.risk_hint: Expose all evidence at once, leaving no cards to play afterward

text.content: Without waiting for others to react, Chen Ji drew a jade slip from his sleeve and gently crushed it—the jade shattered, countless points of light凝聚ing into a phantom image in the air. In the image, Elder Zhou's figure was clearly visible, conversing in hushed tones with a man dressed in Xuanwu Sect attire: '...the weakness in the Tianqing Sect's mountain protection formation lies in that bamboo grove at the back mountain...' As the luminous points danced, Elder Zhou's ashen face was reflected into everyone's eyes.

choices.text: Advance steadily and lure the snake out of its hole
choices.description: First present peripheral evidence, letting Elder Zhou jump out to prevaricate on his own, then dismantle his lies one by one—killing the man while also crushing his spirit, forcing him to watch his disguise torn away layer by layer.
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, giving the opponent room to breathe
choices.visible_reward: Psychologically crushing Elder Zhou completely, exposing the truth only after he's disgraced beyond redemption
choices.risk_hint: If the opponent remains calm, the confrontation may stagnate

text.content: Chen Ji unhurriedly drew a register from his sleeve, placing it gently on the table. 'Elder gentlemen, please examine this—it details the sect's material consumption over the past three months. Why did over three hundred spiritual bamboo stalks in the back mountain grove wither and die within just seven days?' He raised his eyes, his gaze sweeping over Elder Zhou with an almost smile. 'Elder Zhou, you oversee logistics. Do you have an explanation for this?' Elder Zhou's expression shifted slightly, though he forced himself to remain composed. 'Spiritual bamboo withering is a natural disaster—what possible connection could it have to me?'

choices.description: Do not personally level accusations, instead guide Mo Xiansheng and other elders to take the initiative in attacking—turning Elder Zhou into the target of public criticism while standing behind the scenes, manipulating the overall situation.
choices.visible_reward: Protect your biggest trump card while eliminating rivals, escape unscathed
choices.risk_hint: If Mo Xiansheng doesn't cooperate, it might backfire

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his voice平静得近乎谦卑："This disciple is merely a servant, how dare accuse an elder. Only, recently discovering some abnormalities, I dare not conceal them, and specially come to report to Mo Xiansheng for a decision." He presented a thin scroll with both hands, yet his gaze secretly met Mo Xiansheng's illusory form. Mo Xiansheng took the scroll, his remnant soul slightly solidifying, and coldly said: "Oh? Let the old man have a look." Chen Ji retreated to the side with bowed head, the curve at the corner of his lips unseen by anyone.

The atmosphere in the hall suddenly froze. Elder's Zhou's defense sounded especially hollow in the silence. He saw the other elders' gazes gradually shift to scrutiny, even disgust. A chill crawled up his spine from his feet. "You... You slander with impunity!" He abruptly stood up, pointing at Chen Ji, "A废物 servant, daring to slander a sect elder?" Chen Ji静静地看着他暴怒的模样，眼底却是一片冰冷。Anger is the last defense of the guilty—he was precisely waiting for this moment.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji slowly took out that jade slip from his sleeve, his voice not loud, yet each word like a blade) 废物? Elder's Zhou, three months ago you used this jade slip to sell the sect's mountain protection formation layout to the Xuanwu Sect. The jade slip bears your soul mark—would you like to verify it personally?

text.content: Elder's Zhou's face instantly turned ashen white. He stumbled backward, knocking over the tea table behind him. The sound of teacups shattering was especially sharp in the dead silent council hall. "This... This jade slip is forged!" He shrieked, his voice already carrying a hysterical tremor, "Don't listen to him! He is废物! He is—" Mo Xiansheng's illusory form suddenly released a biting pressure, coldly interrupting: "Enough." Two words, yet like thunder exploding, Elder's Zhou's defense stopped abruptly.

choice.prompt: Evidence is conclusive, Elder's Zhou has become a trapped turtle. At this moment Chen Ji faces a critical choice—how to dispose of this traitor who betrayed the sect?

choices.text: Publicly abolish his cultivation on the spot
choices.description: Since we're doing this, we must go all the way. Personally abolish Elder's Zhou's cultivation, turning him from a high-and-mighty elder into the lowest of the low, an eye for an eye, blood for blood.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the骂名 of "harming fellow disciples"
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate Elder's Zhou's threat, earning a reputation for "ruthlessness"
choices.risk_hint: May cause other elders to feel兔死狐悲

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stepped forward slowly, a mass of pale golden spiritual light凝聚 in his palm) Elder's Zhou, when you sold the sect for personal gain, did you ever think this day would come? I have one flaw—I repay kindness tenfold, but I remember a single harm forever. As his words fell, the spiritual light fiercely struck Elder's Zhou's dantian. A shrill scream echoed as all spiritual light around Elder's Zhou dispersed, and he collapsed软绵绵 on the ground like a dog drained of all strength.

choices.text: Leave it to Mo Xiansheng to handle
choices.description: Hand over the disposal power to Mo Xiansheng, both showing respect for elders and allowing Elder's Zhou to receive the harshest punishment—using a blade that isn't your own, keeping yourself clean.
choices.visible_cost: Unable to witness Elder's Zhou's suffering firsthand
choices.visible_reward: Protect yourself while using the situation to completely suppress the remnants of the Five Elders faction
choices.risk_hint: If Mo Xiansheng is soft-hearted, punishment may be too lenient

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji stepped back, bowing respectfully) How dare this disciple overstep. Such a great crime of betraying the sect must be decided by Mo Xiansheng. He stood with bowed head, posture respectfully impeccable, yet his peripheral vision swept across Elder's Zhou's twisted face, lips curving into a faint smile. Mo Xiansheng冷哼一声, his illusory form suddenly solidified, an overwhelming pressure pouring forth like a vast sea: "Zhou Mingyuan, betraying the sect for enemies, unforgivable crime. Guards—abolish his cultivation, expel from the sect, forever banned from setting foot on Tianqing Sect grounds!"

choices.description: Public trial of Elder's Zhou in the sect plaza before all disciples, making him personally confess all crimes—while killing him, thoroughly cleanse the roots of the Five Elders faction.
choices.visible_cost: The动静太大, may attract attention from external forces
choices.visible_reward: Shock all potential traitors at once, establishing a reputation of iron-blooded authority in the sect
choices.risk_hint: If someone causes trouble on the spot, may trigger chaos

text.content: "Chen Ji raised his eyes, his clear voice echoing in the Council Hall: 'Disciple believes this villain's crime should be announced to the entire sect. Both for punishment and warning.' He turned to the surrounding elders, speaking word by word, 'Elders should still remember, ten years ago that demonic path raid, the sect lost thirty-seven disciples. Their blood debt should be repaid by someone.' At these words, several elders' faces changed dramatically. The tragedy ten years ago was still a wound in the sect, and today, finally there was closure."

"Elder Zhou collapsed to the ground, trembling all over. Two law enforcement disciples stepped forward to support him and drag him outside the Council Hall. Just then, several elders inside the hall exchanged glances—they were members of the remnants of the Five Elders' faction. If Elder Zhou fell, would they be next? One of them suddenly stood up, clasped his fists, and said, 'Mo Xiansheng, there are still doubts about this matter. Ruling by conviction based on a single Jade Slip—is that not too hasty?' Before he finished, two more people rose in agreement. The atmosphere in the hall instantly became dagger-drawn."

"Chen Ji watched this scene silently, a cold glint flickering in his eyes. As expected, there were still some jumping clowns. He unhurriedly took out the second and third pieces of evidence from his sleeve—these were 'unexpected gains' he had collected during his secret investigation. 'Elders, please do not be impatient,' his voice was calm, even somewhat respectful, 'Elder Zhou's crimes are not limited to the Jade Slip alone. His correspondence with the Xuanwu Sect, witness testimonies of secret meetings, detailed accounts of embezzled sect assets—would you like to take a look together?' As he spoke, he gently placed a stack of documents on the table. The topmost document赫然 bore an elder's name."

dialogue.content: "(Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul pressure suddenly surged, his illusory figure almost condensing into substance) You several—are you here to plead for Zhou Mingyuan, or do you want to take a trip to the Law Enforcement Hall with him? This old man has lived for hundreds of years; what kind of jumping clowns haven't I seen? If you want to die, keep蹦跶-ing."

text.content: "Those several elders instantly felt as if they had fallen into an icy abyss. Although Mo Xiansheng was merely a remnant soul, his iron-fisted authority when he once commanded the sect was still a legend to this day. Their legs gave way, and they thudded to their knees, repeatedly saying they dared not. As Elder Zhou was dragged out of the Council Hall, he looked back at all this, a flash of manic hatred flickering in his eyes. He hated Chen Ji, but even more, he hated his own carelessness. The seven-day agreement—he should have realized long ago that this废物's sudden proposal of a wager was never about any contest, but rather a trap he had already set, waiting for him to walk right into."

choice.prompt: "Elder Zhou was taken away, but his remaining faction still existed. Chen Ji needed to decide whether to press the advantage and carry the purge through to the end—"

choices.text: "Cut the weeds and eliminate the roots, leave no future troubles"
choices.description: "Strike while the iron is hot, purge Elder Zhou's cronies at once, uproot the remnants of the Five Elders' faction to prevent future troubles."
choices.visible_cost: "Making too many enemies may trigger sect turmoil"
choices.risk_hint: "Actions too large may alert other forces"

text.content: "Chen Ji slightly lowered his eyes, his voice terrifyingly calm: 'Elder Zhou has operated for many years, with cronies spread throughout the sect. Disciple dares to suggest a thorough investigation to clarify matters.' As his words fell, those kneeling elders' faces turned ashen. They wanted to defend themselves, but under Mo Xiansheng's icy gaze, not a single word could escape their lips. Law enforcement disciples filed in, taking them away as well. The Council Hall fell into absolute silence from that moment."

choices.text: "Stop at the right time, know when to quit"
choices.description: "The goal has been achieved, know when to quit. Not only eliminating the greatest threat, but also leaving others a way out—today's mercy will become future leverage."
choices.visible_reward: "Win the reputation of 'magnanimity', making others grateful to you"
choices.risk_hint: "If any survivors counterattack in the future"

text.content: "Chen Ji looked around, his gaze sweeping across the faces of those elders who were too frightened to speak. He suddenly smiled, his expression as warm as spring breeze: 'Elders need not be nervous. Disciple only wishes to eliminate traitors, not become enemies with all of you. In the future, I shall still rely on all elders to jointly support the sect.' At these words, many elders secretly relaxed, and complex emotions flickered in their eyes as they looked at Chen Ji. This youth... is truly unfathomable."

"The trial in the Council Hall concluded. Mo Xiansheng's illusory figure slightly nodded, his gaze toward Chen Ji carrying deeper meaning. 'You did well,' his voice resonated in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, 'but—this is merely the beginning. Zhou Mingyuan is nothing but a chess piece; the real chess player is still in the shadows.' Chen Ji slightly nodded, his eyes deep and profound as an abyss. He naturally knew. Elder Zhou was merely a scapegoat pushed forward; the person standing behind him—that is the true opponent."

dialogue.content: "(Han Lie snorted coldly, turned and left with arms crossed, glaring fiercely at Chen Ji before departing)废物就是废物，只会在背后搞这些见不得人的手段。有本事真刀真枪和我打一场！"

text.content: "Chen Ji gazed at Han Lie's departing figure, a faint smile curving his lips. 真刀真枪? He certainly would—but not now. When he had completed the Tianji Record, when his cultivation had advanced further, this Xuanwu Sect genius would understand what true despair means. He turned and walked out of the Council Hall, night wind brushing his face, bringing a trace of coolness. In the distant horizon, a pale white glow was emerging—a new day was about to begin. And that fragmented map in his hand was radiating a cold, icy light—the secrets of the Ancient Forbidden Land awaited for him to unveil."

dialogue.content: "(Chen Ji lowered his eyes, his voice平静如古井无波) Han Shixiong if wishes to spar, disciple is随时奉陪. Only—has Shixiong ever pondered, how did that protective mountain formation's layout leak to the Xuanwu Sect?"

text.content: "Han Lie's footsteps faltered, his expression slightly changing. He naturally knew—the protective mountain formation's layout had been personally given to Elder Zhou by his father, the Xuanwu Sect Master, as 'sincerity'. But this matter he absolutely could not speak aloud, otherwise it would be admitting that the Xuanwu Sect was the true mastermind behind the scenes. Chen Ji watched his rigid背影, laughed lightly, and walked away. He knew Han Lie would not let this matter rest; this genius's pride would not allow him to be so humiliated by a '废物'. But so what? Just a jumping clown. The real chess game has just begun."

dialogue.content: "(Just as Chen Ji stepped out of the Council Hall, the first page of the Tianji Record in his Mental Sea suddenly burned hot, and Mo Xiansheng's voice abruptly turned solemn) Careful—someone is watching you. Not Zhou Mingyuan, not the Five Elders either. It is... a presence from even higher. This old man sensed a faint, intangible gaze, like—the Eye of Heavenly Way."

text.content: "Chen Ji's footsteps did not halt, yet his heart suddenly tightened. The Eye of Heavenly Way—that legendary existence had actually been watching him all along? He took a deep breath, his expression unchanged on the surface, slowly walking toward his dwelling. Night wind howled, whipping his robes. His hand secretly gripped the fragmented map hidden in his sleeve, a deep, profound light flickering in his eyes. No matter who was watching, he would not retreat. The secrets of the Tianji Record, the truth of the Forbidden Grounds, his sister Chen Nian's whereabouts—whatever he desires, none can stop."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji murmured in a low voice) Since it wants to watch, let it watch. I want to know who set the rules of this chess game. Mo Xiansheng, I've noted it down—the Heavenly Eye. This debt will be settled sooner or later.

text.content: As Elder Zhou was being dragged down the stone steps of the Council Hall by two law enforcement disciples, he suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly. The laughter was mournful like a night owl, echoing especially harshly through the silent night sky: 'Chen Ji! You think killing me ends this? You don't understand the chess game of the Heavenly Eye—you're just an ant!' The laughter faded into the distance, yet the night wind carried it clearly into Chen Ji's ears. He paused and looked back, gazing at that disheveled figure being dragged into the depths of darkness, his gaze cold as frozen stars. Chess game? Heavenly Eye? He snorted lightly and turned to continue walking forward. Whatever chess games, whatever heaven—if anyone dared block his path, he would overturn the entire board and become the one who holds the pieces. The night was deep, the stars dim. And the landscape of the Tianqing Sect, in this single night, had quietly been rewritten.
